name: Reginox

lead: Reginox is described as a botulinum toxin brand made by Hugel. Botulinum toxins are injected into facial muscles to soften expression lines, and some practitioners also inject the masseter to slim the lower face.
Effects appear within days and typically last two to four months.

paras: Treatment is delivered by a clinician with small injections into targeted muscles and repeated when effects wear off.
Side effects of cosmetic botulinum toxin include bruising, headache, temporary weakness of nearby muscles and, rarely, allergic reactions. Masseter injections can reduce chewing strength.

chain: Expression lines soften or the jaw slims
angle.text: Botulinum toxin injections soften lines or reduce muscle bulk in the targeted area for a few months at a time.

lead: Reginox is listed as a Hugel-made botulinum toxin brand, sometimes referred to as "Hugel toxin." Botulinum toxin products are injected into muscles beneath wrinkles, relaxing them so the skin above looks smoother.[1]
Cosmetic botulinum toxin typically shows effect in 3 to 5 days, peaks about a week after injection and lasts roughly 2 to 4 months.[1] Masseter injection can reduce chewing power.[1]

paras: Cosmetic toxin treats glabellar frown lines most commonly; side effects arise from unintended weakening of nearby muscles and include headaches and allergic reactions, with bruising related to injection.[1] The FDA approved Botox Cosmetic for glabellar lines in 2002, after cosmetic use had become widespread.[1]
No studies found on Reginox specifically.
